description: A vintage-style black street lamp with a detailed, ornate design. The lamp features a hexagonal top with intricate patterns and a pointed finial. Below the top, there is a square housing with four clear panels, suggesting it contains a light source. The central pole is twisted and textured, adding to its decorative appeal. It stands on a flattened, oval-shaped base, which appears to be made of a textured material in a light orange or peach color. The overall aesthetic evokes a sense of classic street lighting, often seen in historical districts or elegant outdoor spaces.
